title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Clear no longer replays the device buffer, the Follow filter forgets dead processes, and Run on device works with adb in a path that has a space.

highlights.title: Clear stays cleared
highlights.description: The resume anchor was read from the ring buffer that Clear had just emptied, so the next reconnection started with no anchor and replayed every line you had just cleared.

highlights.title: Follow forgets dead processes
highlights.description: Each restart of the app added a process and kept the previous ones forever. Once Android reused one of those numbers for another app, its lines passed the Follow filter as if they were yours.

highlights.title: Run on device under PowerShell
highlights.description: With adb in a path that has a space, the command started with a quoted path. PowerShell prints such a line instead of running it, so the launch failed with nothing useful on screen.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: A secondary process of the followed app still joins the filter, so a multi process app keeps showing all of its own lines.
The resume anchor now follows the last row actually received, not the oldest row still held in memory.
